retail_cctv.note: Door is outside the frame (bottom right); the yellow line is a convention drawn across the mat corner. Ground truth = people whose feet cross the yellow line, eyeballed from a 1 Hz sweep of the door region (frames 0-110 s, 4 contact sheets) plus the evidence frame of every detected crossing. Times +-1.5 s eyeball precision; tolerance 3 s. Circularity warning: the sweep was viewed after seeing the detections, so recall is measured against what I could see, not an independent label set.
